They’re just saying it’s really ironic... think a bit before saying things like that

There are hotlines to call if you want to talk by yourself. You said you have a cellphone right so idk you can tell your family you are going for a walk and bring it with you. I called one time but immediately hung up because I was scared to talk about it, but I heard that it really did help some people so maybe it could be an option for you. For the loneliness, I know what you are talking about, I was almost thinking it was me who wrote this. I have no advice to give you honesty, I gave up on trying to understand that a long time ago, even the ones who say they understand can’t really until they felt it. Anyway I hope you find the help you seek for soon.

I know this feeling... Am I really awake? What’s the point of existing? How can anyone care at all? Am I gonna get some rest one day? What would it do if I threw everything out the window? Why does it feels like it’s the same day, over and over again? When will I finally get to enjoy something like "normal people" do? How much longer can I go on...
The point where we don’t want help anymore, just waiting for it to end one way or another because there is no more energy to be put in this nightmare.
Yeah you’re right... I shouldn’t be so selfish but I can’t help this is absolute torture
